brief: A 15-second launch film for a note-taking app called Ledger: the problem (notes everywhere), the product appearing, three features, and the launch date "Available today".
notes: The subtitle was only ~8px and readable for 0.9s against a 1.2s read, and the end wordmark was ~11px, so I enlarged the subtitle to 4.5 (readable now ~1.5s, 4.0-6.1s) and the end 'Ledger' to 5. On both wordmarks the Fade and Gradient-letters clips overlapped and fought, so I shortened each Fade and started the gradient only after it ends (Ledger 4.1s, end 13.1s). I also trimmed the three 1.2s headline entrances to <=0.8s, varied the three identical feature Fades into staggered slides so the list leads and reads, and added a slow float through the dead 9.3-10.9s hold.
